BLAKE3 digest computation is infallible for bounded payload sizes; blake3::Hasher::finalize cannot fail
reason: blake3::Hasher::finalize is infallible for any input size. The digest computation in emit_postcard_envelope operates on a bounded byte slice from postcard encoding. blake3 is a pure software implementation with no error path in finalize. Compensating evidence: STATIC-001 (no unsafe), COV-001 (line coverage >90%) confirms the code path is exercised.

claim: CRC32C computation via crc32c::crc32c is infallible for bounded input; no error return path exists
reason: crc32c::crc32c takes a byte slice and u32 initial, returns u32 directly. The function has no error return path - it is a pure CRC computation with no failure mode for any input. Compensating evidence: STATIC-001 (no unsafe), COV-001 (line coverage >90%) confirms the code path is exercised.

claim: serde_yaml::ser::to_string returns Err only for unsupported types or self-referential structures; OutputEnvelope types use Serialize derive with no unsupported cases
reason: serde_yaml::ser::to_string can fail if: (1) the type implements Serialize incorrectly, (2) YAML tags cannot be resolved, or (3) nesting exceeds recursion limit. OutputEnvelope<T> uses serde derive and serializes a flat struct with primitive fields. There are no unsupported types, no self-references, and the recursion depth is bounded by the struct depth. Compensating evidence: PROP-004 (round-trip YAML validity) exercises serialization without error; COV-001 confirms coverage.
